body:
server/relay.js (plain TCP + NDJSON, one cabinet connection, authenticated operator HTTP API) + client/edge_client.c (connects, authenticates, answers a real 'route' command by calling the actual compiled traffic_router.prn decision logic from Phase 0 -- not just an echo). make test-e2e: 6/6 real checks pass (cabinet-connected status, all three real routing decisions, generic ack, operator-token rejection), -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror clean. Found and fixed a real gotcha: the shared PARENA runtime must be the very first #include in any file pulling it in, since it defines _POSIX_C_SOURCE internally which only works before glibc's own headers are touched. Commits 0091eae, 03c22a2 (local, no upstream yet).

⚓ ☃
title: Phase 1 wire protocol -- real client/server, verified end to end (S584)
